claims.statement: Loki is a trickster god in Norse myth.
claims.statement_id: Loki adalah dewa penipu atau pengacau dalam mitologi Nordik.
claims.quote: Loki is a god in Norse mythology who is often simply described as the 'trickster' god

claims.statement: Loki is Odin's sworn brother and sometimes helps other gods out of trouble.
claims.statement_id: Loki menjadi saudara sumpah Odin dan kadang menolong para dewa keluar dari kesulitan.
claims.quote: Sworn brother of Odin and often the one to dig the other gods out of inconveniently deep holes

claims.statement: Loki's role in Baldr's death is linked to the coming of Ragnarök.
claims.statement_id: Peran Loki dalam kematian Baldr dikaitkan dengan datangnya Ragnarök.
claims.quote: the hand he had in the death of the god Baldr, thus setting in motion the coming of the Ragnarök

claims.statement: The article notes no clear Loki cult in the Viking Age.
claims.statement_id: Artikel ini menyatakan tidak ada kultus Loki yang jelas pada zaman Viking.
claims.quote: With no cult attached to him and no clear function in Viking Age belief

claims.statement: Snorri Sturluson's Prose Edda is a major source about Loki.
claims.statement_id: Edda Prosa karya Snorri Sturluson adalah sumber utama informasi tentang Loki.
claims.quote: The richest amount of information on Loki can be mined from Snorri Sturluson's Prose Edda

claims.statement: Loki is said to change into a hawk, fly, flea, salmon, seal, young woman, old woman, or mare.
claims.statement_id: Loki dikisahkan berubah menjadi elang, lalat, pinjal, salmon, anjing laut, perempuan muda, perempuan tua, hingga kuda betina.
claims.quote: Various sources record Loki shape-shifting into a hawk; a fly & a flea; a salmon & a seal; and even a young maiden, an old hag & a mare.

claims.statement: In the Prose Edda Loki is the son of Fárbauti and Laufey or Nál.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Edda Prosa, Loki adalah putra Fárbauti dan Laufey atau Nál.
claims.quote: Snorri's Prose Edda has Loki down as son of the giant Fárbauti and a mother named Laufey or Nál.

claims.statement: Sigyn is Loki's wife and Nari or Narfi is their son.
claims.statement_id: Sigyn adalah istri Loki dan Nari atau Narfi disebut putra mereka.
claims.quote: with his wife Sigyn he had a son named Nari or Narfi.

claims.statement: Fenrir, the Midgard Serpent, and Hel are named as children of Loki and Angrboda.
claims.statement_id: Fenrir, ular Midgard, dan Hel disebut sebagai anak Loki dan Angrboda.
claims.quote: the wolf Fenrir, the Midgard Serpent who coils around the world, and Hel, goddess of the Underworld

claims.statement: Loki changes into a mare and gives birth to eight-legged Sleipnir.
claims.statement_id: Loki berubah menjadi kuda betina dan melahirkan Sleipnir berkaki delapan.
claims.quote: Loki shape-shifts into a mare and gives birth to the eight-legged horse Sleipnir

claims.statement: When Loki is punished with dripping venom, Sigyn catches much of it in a bowl.
claims.statement_id: Saat Loki dihukum dengan tetesan bisa, Sigyn menadah sebagian besarnya dalam mangkuk.
claims.quote: his wife Sigyn catches the worst of it in a bowl.

claims.statement: In the necklace story, Freyja's house was locked and Loki turned himself into a fly to get inside.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah kalung Freyja, rumah Freyja terkunci dan Loki berubah menjadi lalat untuk masuk.
claims.quote: But Freyja’s house was locked. To get inside, Loki turned himself into a fly.

claims.statement: Loki changed into a flea, bit her cheek, waited until she turned in her sleep, then undid the clasp and took the necklace without waking her.
claims.statement_id: Loki berubah menjadi pinjal, menggigit pipinya, menunggu ia berbalik dalam tidurnya, lalu membuka kaitan dan membawa pergi kalung itu tanpa membangunkannya.
claims.quote: He changed into a flea, bit her on the cheek, and waited until she turned in her sleep. Then he undid the clasp, took the necklace, and left the house without waking her.

claims.statement: Skadi's condition was that the gods make her laugh; Loki then tied a rope to a goat's beard and the other end to his own body.
claims.statement_id: Skadi mensyaratkan para dewa membuatnya tertawa; Loki lalu mengikat seutas tali pada janggut kambing dan ujung lainnya pada tubuhnya.
claims.quote: Skadi herself set a further condition in order to forgo her revenge: the gods had to make her laugh. Loki then tied a rope to a goat’s beard and the other end to his testicles.

claims.statement: In this translation of the Prose Edda, Loki is called the originator of deceit and the disgrace of all gods and men; his name is Loke, or Lopt.
claims.statement_id: Dalam terjemahan Edda Prosa ini, Loki disebut pencetus tipu daya dan aib bagi semua dewa dan manusia; namanya Loke atau Lopt.
claims.quote: He is the originator of deceit, and the disgrace of all gods and men. His name is Loke, or Lopt.

claims.statement: The Prose Edda describes Loke as fair of face but evil in disposition and very fickle-minded.
claims.statement_id: Edda Prosa menggambarkan Loke berparas rupawan, tetapi berwatak jahat dan sangat labil.
claims.quote: Loke is fair and beautiful of face, but evil in disposition, and very fickle-minded.

claims.statement: According to the Prose Edda, Loke has often brought the asas into great trouble and often helped them out again with his cunning contrivances.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Edda Prosa, Loke sering menjerumuskan para asa ke dalam kesulitan besar dan sering pula menolong mereka keluar lewat tipu dayanya.
claims.quote: He has often brought the asas into great trouble, and often helped them out again, with his cunning contrivances.

claims.statement: The Prose Edda names Byleist and Helblinde as Loke's brothers.
claims.statement_id: Edda Prosa menyebut saudara-saudara Loke adalah Byleist dan Helblinde.
claims.quote: His brothers are Byleist and Helblinde.

claims.statement: In the story of the builder, a frightened Loke swears an oath that he will make the builder lose his wages.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah pembangun benteng, Loke yang ketakutan bersumpah akan membuat si pembangun kehilangan upahnya.
claims.quote: He in his fright then promised with an oath that he should so manage that the builder should lose his wages, let it cost him what it would.

claims.statement: After racing with Svadilfare, Loke bore a gray foal with eight feet, the best horse among gods and men.
claims.statement_id: Setelah berlomba dengan Svadilfare, Loke melahirkan anak kuda abu-abu berkaki delapan, kuda terbaik di antara dewa dan manusia.
claims.quote: But Loke had run such a race with Svadilfare that he some time after bore a foal. It was gray, and had eight feet, and this is the best horse among gods and men.

claims.statement: Hoder shot Balder with the mistletoe under Loke's guidance; the dart pierced him and he fell dead.
claims.statement_id: Hoder menembak Balder dengan tangkai mistletoe di bawah arahan Loke; panah itu menembusnya dan ia jatuh tewas.
claims.quote: Hoder took the mistletoe and shot at Balder under the guidance of Loke. The dart pierced him and he fell dead to the ground.

claims.statement: After Balder's death, Loke often took the likeness of a salmon by day and hid in Frananger Force.
claims.statement_id: Setelah kematian Balder, Loke sering di siang hari berwujud salmon dan bersembunyi di air terjun Frananger.
claims.quote: Oftentimes in the daytime he took on him the likeness of a salmon and concealed himself in Frananger Force.

claims.statement: Loke was finally taken without truce and brought to a cave.
claims.statement_id: Loke akhirnya ditangkap tanpa gencatan dan dibawa ke sebuah gua.
claims.quote: Now Loke was taken without truce and was brought to a cave.

claims.statement: In the Prose Edda, Loke twists so violently that the whole earth shakes, which is called earthquakes, and he lies bound there until Ragnarok.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Edda Prosa, Loke menggeliat sampai seluruh bumi bergetar, yang disebut gempa bumi, dan ia terikat di sana sampai Ragnarok.
claims.quote: Then he twists his body so violently that the whole earth shakes, and this you call earthquakes. There he will lie bound until Ragnarok.

claims.statement: At Ragnarok, Loke comes to the battle plain with Hrym and all the frost-giants.
claims.statement_id: Pada Ragnarok, Loke datang ke dataran pertempuran bersama Hrym dan semua raksasa es.
claims.quote: To this place have also come Loke and Hrym, and with him all the frost-giants.

claims.statement: In the Prose Edda, Loke fights Heimdal and they kill each other.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Edda Prosa, Loke bertarung dengan Heimdal dan keduanya saling membunuh.
claims.quote: Loke fights with Heimdal, and they kill each other.

claims.statement: At the agreed time, Loke coaxed Idun out of Asgard into a forest, saying he had found very nice apples.
claims.statement_id: Pada waktu yang dijanjikan, Loke membujuk Idun keluar dari Asgard ke hutan dengan alasan telah menemukan apel yang bagus.
claims.quote: But at the time agreed upon, Loke coaxed Idun out of Asgard into a forest, saying that he had found apples that she would think very nice

claims.statement: Loke turned Idun into the likeness of a nut, held her in his claws and flew with all his might.
claims.statement_id: Loke mengubah Idun menjadi rupa kacang, mencengkeramnya dengan cakar, dan terbang secepat mungkin.
claims.quote: Loke turned her into the likeness of a nut, held her in his claws and flew with all his might.

claims.quote: Whenever he was on earth in search of a victim, Pluto rode in a chariot of gold drawn by four coal-black steeds.
